data.title: How Much of Your Portfolio Should Be in Bitcoin After JPMorgan’s 10% Forecast?
data.description: JPMorgan just gave Bitcoin a place in serious long-term forecasts, but the projected return tells only half the story. The other half, rooted in volatility that can carve 50% from your holdings, determines whether any allocation makes sense for your situation.
